Merlin M842 434MHz 4Button Transmitter

Upgrade or replace your garage and gate system access with the Merlin M842 434MHz 4Button Transmitter, available from All Remotes. This robust 4-channel transmitter is engineered to operate seamlessly with compatible Merlin receivers, giving you reliable daily access to your property.

What's Included

", "compatibility": "

The Merlin M842 434MHz 4Button Transmitter is designed to work with specific Merlin receivers and operators. Important: Ensure your receiver matches the 434MHz frequency and supports learning functions before purchase.

  • M230T receiver and operator models (with 'Learn' button)
  • M430R receiver and operator models (with 'Learn' button)
  • Direct replacement for RK-RCM19 (M832) remotes
", "instructions": "

Programming Instructions

  1. Locate the 'Learn' button on your Merlin garage door opener or external receiver module.
  2. Press and release the 'Learn' button once. The indicator LED will illuminate or flash.
  3. Press any button on your new Merlin M842 transmitter for two seconds, then release.
  4. The opener light or LED will flash or turn off, indicating successful code registration.
  5. Test the remote by pressing the programmed button to operate the door.

Deletion Instructions

  1. Press and hold the 'Learn' button on your garage door opener or receiver.
  2. Keep holding the button until the indicator light turns off (usually about 6 seconds).
  3. All stored remote codes are now erased from the memory.
  4. Re-program any required remotes using the standard programming steps.

result.instructions:
Programming Instructions


  1. Locate the 'Learn' button on your Merlin garage door opener or external receiver module.
  2. Press and release the 'Learn' button once. The indicator LED will illuminate or flash.
  3. Press any button on your new Merlin M842 transmitter for two seconds, then release.
  4. The opener light or LED will flash or turn off, indicating successful code registration.
  5. Test the remote by pressing the programmed button to operate the door.

Deletion Instructions


  1. Press and hold the 'Learn' button on your garage door opener or receiver.
  2. Keep holding the button until the indicator light turns off (usually about 6 seconds).
  3. All stored remote codes are now erased from the memory.
  4. Re-program any required remotes using the standard programming steps.
